notes.title: A smol qol update
notes.content:
[u]List of the fixes for this patch 1.0.4:[/u]

[list]
[*] Menu Legibility improved
[*] Control Scheme improved for the menus
[*] Added a skip cutscenes function - hold A to skip.
[*] Steam Cloud Functionality - this should work going forward.
[*] Demo Issues on Steam Deck: there was a rogue in-progress Linux version hanging around so this should be fixed now.
[/list]

Thanks to those leaving feedback and reviews. And all the streamers playing and saying nice things about the game. A common theme seems to be being called a "HIDDEN GEM" which I do like, but if you fancy telling your friends about Tempus Bound and spreading the good word, that would be awesome. Still trying to hit my personal goal of 50 reviews ːsteamhappyː

Cogs are turning, something is in motion.....more soon... 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39247894/09cf2357e97669d8ad432fc67881d8890259b246.gif[/img]


JAs x

notes.title: Hotfix #3
notes.content:
Hi Folks! Hope you're enjoying the game, thanks for playing and your kind reviews! <3

This update fixes :
- the checking of achivements before entering a secret door. (thanks to Missi for finding this)
- Using the map teleportation jump now works, as opposed to getting stuck in the void on the way out to your chosen location!

Thanks for the feedback!

notes.title: Hotfix #2
notes.content:
Now plays perfectly on Steamdeck!
- Entry now rightfully granted to those who seek the Ultimate Ending.
- Main ending achievement now triggering (should work retroactively) - thanks to Missi for finding this one!
- Crate getting stuck around gate fix - thanks to JUICY for finding this one.
- Tail should be wiggling properly now - thanks to TapButton for finding this one!
- Player returning sooner after the disc puzzle.
- Intro cinematic largely skipped once you've made it to the 2nd or 3rd area (or hold jump to skip anyway)
- Ghosting cave mushrooms returning sooner.

+ Many other small tweaks.

notes.title: #1 Hotfix in early
notes.content:
First of all thanks for picking up Tempus Bound on Day 1, you're amazing and the support has been overwhelming. After this I will hopefully have a quiet(ish) weekend!

Fixes include:

- Hidden speedrunning mode from main menu (for now)
- Changed super secret ending entry requirements...
- Fixed niche sticky rope issue

Thanks again!

Jas
